versions.changelog:
Initial release of the long-form male-oriented web novel writing assistant.

- Supports multi-novel project management with independent directories.
- Implements chapter memory management and context recall for up to 10 previous chapters.
- Provides AI-style removal, ensuring writing style is close to popular novels like 《斗破苍穹》.
- Includes auto self-check and repair for chapters inconsistent with the outline or style.
- Enforces strict minimum chapter length (2000+ words) before allowing progression.
- Offers structured outlining, character/system/world setting tools, and review/repair workflows.
